summary: rec.gov: fees 14-20 -> 14-26 (2026 table: $14 non-electric, $26 electric); 50 A + water, 26 sites, 2 pull-throughs, max 55; flush/vault/showers/dump; 14-night max, 3-night holiday minimum. Not waterfront kept (creek 110+ m through dense woods).
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Dragoon Creek runs ~110-130 m north of the nearest sites (26, 27, 29) and ~130-160 m from the 01-15 row, through continuous dense woods (Esri and NAIP 2026-11-06); the channel is ~25-35 m wide. No view, nothing to earn.
SITES: rec.gov's description says 32 campsites (29 electric/water); the catalog lists 26 (22 electric, 4 non-electric, numbers 19, 25 and 28 missing). Count 26 kept from the catalog.
SEASON not written: only the rate season (05-01..09-29) is published.
